nodes.text: Batch retrieve nitride polymorphs from Materials Project
74 polymorphs retrieved from 35 compositions; 5 compositions failed
Consolidate polymorph datasets into single file
Prepare tabular dataset with advanced feature engineering
Dataset prepared: 59 train samples, 15 test samples, 18 features
Train XGBoost model with specified hyperparameters
XGBoost trained: test MAE=0.175, RMSE=0.215, R²=0.884; train R²=0.9996
Evaluate XGBoost model on test set with detailed analysis
Evaluation: MAE=0.175, RMSE=0.215, R²=0.884; top feature: electronegativity_diff (33.2%)
Model shows good test performance (R²=0.884); cross-validation shows reasonable generalization with variability due to small dataset

support.quote: The model shows good performance on the test set with an R² of 0.884, indicating it can explain about 88% of the variance in formation energies. The most important features are electronegativity difference (33.2%), lattice volume (24.7%), and packing efficiency (22.6%). The cross-validation results show reasonable generalization with a mean R² of 0.738, though with some variability (std: 0.226), which is expected given the relatively small dataset size.
